game.name: Amped 3 (Europe)(En,Fr,De,It)
game.desc: Amped 3 on Xbox 360 puts you on a snowboard for some fiery downhill runs. Choose your rider, from the most believable to the most ridiculous, and launch yourself down crazy mountains. And if you can't get enough, switch to the snow park editor which allows you to do just about anything you want on the slopes.
